description: Niger : Aéroports is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Niger. Ce jeu de données fournit la liste complète des aéroports opérationnels ainsi que les types d'aéronefs autorisés à y atterrir, accompagné de chaque nom ou identifiant unique correspondant. Coverage: Niger. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Niger. Its tags are aviation, geodata. The portal shows 2024-01-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
